rounds.text: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Ltd trades at an attractive P/E multiple of 14.5x [E1], which sits well below the sector benchmark of 28.18x [E6], while generating robust returns including an ROE of 18.8% [E13] and an ROCE of 20.1% [E12] that easily outstrip their respective sector benchmarks of 8.14% and 9.61% [E9, E10]. Profit growth has been exceptionally strong, evidenced by a 39% compounded growth rate over five years [E19] and a 37% jump over the trailing twelve months [E21], supported by recent margin expansion such as a quarterly operating margin of 10% in June 2026 compared to 7% in the year-ago period [E31]. Valuation models underscore this mispricing, with a discounted cash flow analysis indicating an intrinsic value of Rs 939 per share against a market price of Rs 327 [E43], leaving a substantial margin of safety of 65.2% [E44] where the current share price only prices in a modest 3.5% earnings growth rate [E45]. Furthermore, the business benefits from strong momentum with a relative-strength rating of 100 [E49], a rules-based screen score of 94 out of 100 [E58], and a supportive Consumer Durables sector tailwind with a score of +0.98 [E67]. Conceded: [E57] the company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.2% over past five years, and conceded: [E52] annualised volatility is high at 69.8%.

The bull thesis rests heavily on backward-looking profitability and recent momentum, yet underlying operational indicators flash warning signs that expectations are running hot. Conceded: [E6]. Specifically, price growth has recently exceeded profit growth by 48 percent, signalling that market expectations are running well ahead of actual delivery [E55]. Furthermore, the screening engines explicitly flag that earnings growth is decelerating [E63], and the company has delivered a poor sales growth rate of just 10.2 percent over the past five years [E57]. Operating-margin trends compound this concern, reading as inconsistent over both the last two years and the last two quarters [E32, E33]. Investors also face extreme downside volatility, evidenced by a staggering historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -81.0 percent alongside an annualized volatility of 69.8 percent [E51, E52]. Finally, promoter shareholding has drifted downward from 73.60 percent in September 2023 to 72.82 percent as of June 2026 [E41].

Conceded: [E32, E33] regarding the inconsistent operating-margin trend over the last two years and quarters, though this minor fluctuation sits alongside an expanding operating margin that rose to 9% in the TTM from 7% three years earlier and hit 10% in June 2026 [E30, E31]. Conceded: [E51] regarding the historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -81.0%, and [E41] regarding the slight drift in promoter shareholding from 73.60% to 72.82%, but these historical risks are heavily outweighed by a robust rules-based screen scoring 94 out of 100 with high confidence [E58]. Conceded: [E57] concerning the five-year sales growth rate, yet the business has accelerated dramatically with trailing twelve-month sales growth of 14% [E17] and recent quarterly surges showing sales up 23% year-over-year [E59]. The worry over decelerating earnings growth [E63] is directly contradicted by a stellar trailing twelve-month profit growth of 37% [E21] and net profit leaping 64% year-over-year [E61]. Finally, while price growth exceeding profit growth [E55] indicates high expectations, the stock still trades at an attractive P/E of 14.5x [E1] and an EV/EBITDA of 9.58x against a sector benchmark of 14.65x [E11], all backed by a powerful Consumer Durables sector tailwind score of +0.98 [E65].

Conceded: [E30, E31] regarding the rise in TTM and quarterly operating margins, but this expansion is undermined by the inconsistent yearly and quarterly margin trends over the last two years [E32, E33]. Conceded: [E21, E61] regarding recent profit growth surges, yet the rules-based screen explicitly flags that earnings growth is decelerating [E63]. Conceded: [E11] regarding the lower EV/EBITDA multiple compared to the sector, but the price growth has outpaced profit growth by 48%, showing that market expectations are running well ahead of actual delivery [E55]. Conceded: [E1, E11] regarding attractive valuation multiples, but the stock sits 95% of the way up its 52-week range and just -2.3% away from its high [E46, E47], carrying an annualized volatility of 69.8% [E52] alongside a severe historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -81.0% [E51]. Finally, the five-year sales growth is flagged as poor at 10.2% [E57], and insider selling is evidenced by promoter shareholding dropping from 73.60% to 72.82% [E41].

Conceded: [E32, E33] regarding inconsistent short-term margin trends, but this overlooks the concrete expansion in TTM and quarterly operating margins to 9% and 10% [E30, E31]. Conceded: [E63] regarding the screen flag for decelerating earnings growth, yet recent annualized and TTM profit growth figures remain exceptionally robust at 37% and 39% [E19, E21]. Conceded: [E55] regarding price growth outpacing profit growth, but the valuation remains exceptionally attractive with a P/E of 14.5x against a sector benchmark of 28.18x [E1, E6], alongside a discounted cash flow intrinsic value yielding a massive 65.2% margin of safety [E43, E44]. Conceded: [E46, E47, E51, E52] regarding proximity to 52-week highs and high historical volatility, but the price strength is backed by pristine technicals with the stock trading above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages and a relative-strength rating of 100 [E48, E49]. Conceded: [E41, E57] regarding minor promoter selling and a five-year sales growth flag, but promoters still retain a commanding 72.82% stake [E41] while return on capital employed stands at an impressive 20.1% [E12] easily outperforming the sector benchmark of 9.61% [E10].

Conceded: [E30, E31] regarding expanding operating margins. However, citing robust TTM profit growth of 37% [E21] ignores the explicit screen flag that earnings growth is actively decelerating [E63]. While the bull leans on a discounted cash flow valuation to claim a massive margin of safety [E43, E44], the baseline reality is that recent price growth has outpaced profit growth by 48%, showing that market expectations are running well ahead of actual delivery [E55]. Conceded: [E48, E49] regarding positive moving averages and a relative-strength rating of 100, but this intense momentum comes hand-in-hand with an annualized volatility of 69.8% and a brutal historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -81.0% [E51, E52], exposing long-term holders to catastrophic downside risk. Conceded: [E12, E41] regarding a high ROCE of 20.1% and a controlling promoter stake of 72.82%, yet that same promoter stake has actively drifted downward over time [E41], and the company is saddled with an official flag for poor sales growth of 10.2% over the past five years [E57].
